summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $194,999,999.75 in Class A ordinary shares through AC Sunshine Securities LLC as sales agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation. Shares are listed on Nasdaq under PAVS; last sale price was $1.04 on June 4, 2026. Compensation is 3.5% commission. There are no M&A, restructuring, or activist elements; this is a standard capital-raising mechanism with no event-driven trigger.
